import FreeEntropy.Theorem1Complete

noncomputable section
open Matrix Filter
open scoped Topology BigOperators
open FreeEntropy FreeEntropy.Channels FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl

-- Reconstructed directly from article.tex eq:result, with zero-based indices.
private def sourceL (d r : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (r : ℝ) * (2 * (d : ℝ) - (r : ℝ) - 1) / 2 * Real.logb 2 n +
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) r, Real.logb 2 (x i - x j)) +
    ((d - r : ℕ) : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, Real.logb 2 (x i)) -
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (d - r) d, Real.logb 2 (k.factorial : ℝ)

-- The inspected physicalSource is the tensor power of U diag(x) U†.
example {d r : ℕ} (s : FixedSpectrum d r) :
    ∃ memory : ℕ → ℕ,
      ∃ E : ∀ n, MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)),
      ∃ D : ∀ n, MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d),
        Tendsto (fun n => Real.logb 2 (memory n) - sourceL d r s.eigenvalue n) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Asymptotics.IsBigO atTop
          (fun n => sSup (Set.range (fun U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ =>
            TraceDistance.traceDistance ((D n).toFun ((E n).toFun (physicalSource s n U)))
              (physicalSource s n U))))
          (fun n : ℕ => Real.logb 2 n / Real.sqrt n) ∧
        Tendsto (fun n => mixedWorstError s n (E n) (D n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  exact FreeEntropy.theorem1_achievability s

example {d r : ℕ} (s : FixedSpectrum d r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
    (E : ∀ n, MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
    (D : ∀ n, MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d))
    (herror : Tendsto (fun n =>
      ∫ U, TraceDistance.traceDistance ((D n).toFun ((E n).toFun (physicalSource s n U)))
        (physicalSource s n U) ∂UnitaryHaar.probabilityHaar (Fin d)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    (0 : EReal) ≤ liminf
      (fun n => ((Real.logb 2 (memory n) - sourceL d r s.eigenvalue n : ℝ) : EReal)) atTop := by
  exact FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse s memory E D herror

example {d r : ℕ} (s : FixedSpectrum d r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
    (E : ∀ n, MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
    (D : ∀ n, MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d))
    (herror : Tendsto (fun n => sSup (Set.range (fun U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ =>
      TraceDistance.traceDistance ((D n).toFun ((E n).toFun (physicalSource s n U)))
        (physicalSource s n U)))) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    (0 : EReal) ≤ liminf
      (fun n => ((Real.logb 2 (memory n) - sourceL d r s.eigenvalue n : ℝ) : EReal)) atTop := by
  exact FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse_of_uniform s memory E D herror

#print axioms FreeEntropy.theorem1_achievability
#print axioms FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse
#print axioms FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse_of_uniform

-- No zero-dimensional-memory/log(0) loophole survives the actual channel premise.
example {d r : ℕ} (s : FixedSpectrum d r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
    (E : ∀ n, MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n))) :
    ∀ n, 0 < memory n := by
  intro n
  exact Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mpr
    (channel_target_nonempty (E n) (physicalSource s n 1) (physicalSource_trace s n 1))

import FreeEntropy.Theorem2Choi
import FreeEntropy.PhysicalOrbitChannels

open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators
open FreeEntropy FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation

-- Independently reconstructed source type, with scalar definitions expanded.
example {d r : ℕ} (s : FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
    (hmu_support : ∀ i : Fin d, r ≤ i.val → mu i = 0)
    (hnu_support : ∀ i : Fin d, r ≤ i.val → nu i = 0)
    (hinc : Antitone (fun i => (nu i : ℝ) - (mu i : ℝ)))
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) :
    TraceDistance.traceNorm
      (prvForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc (canonicalOrbitState s mu U) - canonicalOrbitState s nu U) / 2 ≤
      ((d.choose 2 : ℝ) + 3 * ((r.choose 2 : ℝ) * s.qx / (1 - s.qx) ^ (r.choose 2 + 1))) *
        ((∑ i, Int.natAbs ((nu i : ℤ) - (mu i : ℤ)) : ℕ) : ℝ) /
          ((minimumRowGap mu r hd s.rank_pos : ℝ) + 1) ∧
    TraceDistance.traceNorm
      (prvReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc (canonicalOrbitState s nu U) - canonicalOrbitState s mu U) / 2 ≤
      ((d.choose 2 : ℝ) + 3 * ((r.choose 2 : ℝ) * s.qx / (1 - s.qx) ^ (r.choose 2 + 1))) *
        ((∑ i, Int.natAbs ((nu i : ℤ) - (mu i : ℤ)) : ℕ) : ℝ) /
          ((minimumRowGap mu r hd s.rank_pos : ℝ) + 1) := by
  exact theorem2_cloning_accuracy_choi s hd mu nu hmu hnu hmu_support hnu_support hinc U

-- Literal normalized Choi contractions are actual channels on all matrices.
example {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
    (hinc : Antitone (fun i => (nu i : ℝ) - (mu i : ℝ))) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∃ F : Channels.MatrixChannel (IrrepIndex mu) (IrrepIndex nu),
      ∃ R : Channels.MatrixChannel (IrrepIndex nu) (IrrepIndex mu),
        F.toFun = prvForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc ∧
        R.toFun = prvReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc := by
  exact prv_maps_are_channels mu nu hmu hnu hinc hd

#print axioms FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.theorem2_cloning_accuracy_choi
#print axioms FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prv_maps_are_channels
#print FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.theorem2_cloning_accuracy_choi

-- Term-level source-characterization consumption on both supported partitions.
open FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl in
example {d r : ℕ} (s : FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
    (hmu_support : ∀ i : Fin d, r ≤ i.val → mu i = 0)
    (hnu_support : ∀ i : Fin d, r ≤ i.val → nu i = 0)
    (hinc : Antitone (fun i => (nu i : ℝ) - (mu i : ℝ)))
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) :
    TraceDistance.traceDistance
      (prvForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc (canonicalWeightTensorState mu (physicalDensity s U)))
      (canonicalWeightTensorState nu (physicalDensity s U)) ≤
        Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx * (differenceNorm mu nu : ℝ) /
          ((minimumRowGap mu r hd s.rank_pos : ℝ) + 1) ∧
    TraceDistance.traceDistance
      (prvReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc (canonicalWeightTensorState nu (physicalDensity s U)))
      (canonicalWeightTensorState mu (physicalDensity s U)) ≤
        Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx * (differenceNorm mu nu : ℝ) /
          ((minimumRowGap mu r hd s.rank_pos : ℝ) + 1) := by
  rw [canonicalWeightTensorState_eq_orbit s mu hmu hmu_support U,
    canonicalWeightTensorState_eq_orbit s nu hnu hnu_support U]
  exact theorem2_cloning_accuracy_choi s hd mu nu hmu hnu hmu_support hnu_support hinc U

#print axioms FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.canonicalWeightTensorState_eq_orbit
